items.title: Online Gaming Application Form- PAGE 6: QUESTION 34
items.description: Since Ancient Achievers N.V. does not have a local managing director, the proxy holder, Downtown E-Commerce Company B.V., which is registered as the local representative in the Chamber of Commerce excerpt, will need to assume this role. To complete this process: 1. We require an official board declaration stating the authority of the proxyholder Downtown E-Commerce Company B.V. to open the account. 2. A request via egl-applications@gcb.cw, to modify the Portal Administrator with the correct name and contact details as instructed. When these steps are completed, kindly correct question 34 and resubmit the form.
